title: Recurring dreams about missiles raining down from the sky
content: I've been having these weird dreams/nightmares lately where I'm standing outside (sometimes with a loved one) and watching hundreds of missiles just raining down from the sky. Oddly, I'm not scared in these dreams as I would be in such a situation, just an oddly calm acceptance that it's the end. I live in the U.S. and have never been anywhere near a warzone, so idk why I'm having these kinds of recurring, specific dreams. Any thoughts?
